value.description: Build an expandable raft made of pieces. The first invention that enabled humanity to cross the ocean.
Build a ship's hull using early technology. It's narrow but reasonably sturdy.
Build a massive, robust ship's hull. It is reinforced with iron. It will surely prove its worth in battle.
Build a comfortable boat with excellent space efficiency. Additional decks can be added. It is, in a sense, a raft built with advanced technology.
